description: Use this once right after ChefBear is connected, or when the user asks whether ChefBear is connected or what it may do. Returns only this connection's own permissions (scopes) and app name, with no account or menu data. For an account that has not used the ChefBear app yet, it also says how many menu recognitions are left today and where to get the app.
name: connection_status

app.description: Where to get the ChefBear app, which is optional. Mention it once, not in every answer.

scansLeftToday.description: Menu recognitions (import_menu) this account has left today (UTC). Using the ChefBear app once lifts the limit.

title: Check the connection
